This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Bix Creo]] was a member of this species.<ref name="Gamefront" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was distinguished by [[Color/Legends|gray-brown]] skin, with digitigrade [[Limb/Legends|legs]] and three-long-toed feet. Their arms were long, with their three-fingered hands dangling around their upper knees. They had elongated [[Bone/Legends|craniums]], with pointed chins, downturned [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]], seemingly exposed [[Nose/Legends|nostrils]], solid black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="Gamefront" />

==Society and culture==
One member of this species, [[Bix Creo]], was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]<ref name="Gamefront" /> who was active during the reign of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] between [[130 ABY]] and [[138 ABY]].<ref name="Dating note">{{WebCite|url=https://www.gameinformer.com/b/features/archive/2014/04/09/art-from-the-darth-maul-game-you-39-ll-never-get-to-play.aspx|text=Art From The Darth Maul Game You'll Never Get To Play|author=Andrew Reiner|date=2014-04-09|work=[[Wikipedia:Game Informer|''Game Informer'']]|archivedate=20240223064541|nolive=1}} &mdash; ''[[Battle of the Sith Lords]]'' would have taken place during the reign of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. [[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]] states that [[Darth Krayt|Krayt's]] Empire was founded in [[130 ABY]]. The Empire was dissolved in [[138 ABY]], as depicted in [[Legacy—War 6|''Legacy—War'' 6]]. Therefore, Bix Creo must have been active between those two dates.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This species was created for [[Red Fly Studio]]'s canceled [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Battle of the Sith Lords]]''.<ref name="Gamefront" /> They were designed by concept artist [[Thomas A. Szakolczay]]<ref name="Gamefront" /> at some point prior to the game's cancellation in [[2011]].<ref name="GI subscription article">{{WebCite|url=http://www.gameinformer.com/b/features/archive/2014/05/07/the-story-of-the-darth-maul-game-that-never-came-to-be.aspx?PostPageIndex=1|text=The Story Of The Darth Maul Game That Never Came To Be|author=Reiner, Andrew|date=2014-05-07|archivedate=20160219184903|nolive=1}}</ref>
